components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 42px; padding: 0 15px; color: #fff; background: #68458f; border: 2px solid #202942; border-radius: 7px 15px; box-shadow: 0 3px 0 rgba(32, 41, 66, .35); font: 800 15px/1.4 Avenir Next, Avenir, Trebuchet MS, sans-serif; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-primary:active { box-shadow: none; transform: translateY(2px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f6b84c; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Load Button
components.css: .ds-btn-load { min-height: 42px; padding: 0 15px; color: #202942; background: #f1d3a0; border: 2px solid #d99b33; border-radius: 7px 15px; box-shadow: 0 3px 0 rgba(32, 41, 66, .35); font: 800 15px/1.4 Avenir Next, Avenir, Trebuchet MS, sans-serif; } .ds-btn-load:hover { filter: brightness(1.05); } .ds-btn-load:active { box-shadow: none; transform: translateY(2px); } .ds-btn-load:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f6b84c; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Operator Input
components.description: A labeled, warm-paper event or search field.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 5px; color: #5b6171; font: 900 11px/1 Avenir Next, Avenir, Trebuchet MS, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-field input { min-height: 42px; padding: 0 12px; color: #202942; background: #fffdf7; border: 2px solid #8d94a8; border-radius: 7px 15px; font: 500 15px/1.4 Avenir Next, Avenir, Trebuchet MS, sans-serif; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f6b84c; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Phase Tab
components.css: .ds-phase { min-height: 38px; padding: 0 13px; color: #68458f; background: transparent; border: 0; border-bottom: 3px solid #68458f; font: 800 15px/1.4 Avenir Next, Avenir, Trebuchet MS, sans-serif; } .ds-phase small { margin-left: 7px; padding: 2px 6px; color: #202942; background: #ded9cc; border-radius: 999px; } .ds-phase:hover { background: rgba(104, 69, 143, .06); } .ds-phase:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f6b84c; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Live Status
components.description: A textual freshness or connection indicator.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 7px; color: #74d8ad; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 999px; font: 900 10px/1 Avenir Next, Avenir, Trebuchet MS, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-status i { width: 8px; height: 8px; background: currentColor; border-radius: 50%; }

components.name: Set Card
components.description: A compact bracket set on warm tournament paper.
components.css: .ds-set { position: relative; display: grid; gap: 7px; padding: 9px 11px 11px; color: #202942; background: #f8f5ec; border: 2px solid #a5a096; border-radius: 7px 17px; box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(32, 41, 66, .1); font-family: Avenir Next, Avenir, Trebuchet MS, sans-serif; } .ds-set::before { position: absolute; inset: 0 auto 0 0; width: 4px; background: #d99b33; content: ''; } .ds-set span { color: #5b6171; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: .07em; } .ds-set div { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 750; } .ds-set strong { display: grid; width: 25px; height: 25px; place-items: center; color: #fff; background: #202942; border-radius: 5px 10px; } .ds-set:hover { border-color: #68458f; } .ds-set:focus-within { outline: 3px solid #f6b84c; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: Tournament Overlay combines a practical event operations desk with the tactile, slightly whimsical nautical identity of the Octagon broadcast package. The dashboard is paper-forward and dense enough to scan bracket flow quickly; its command bar and scene rail use deep navy to signal durable controls and current broadcast state. Decoration must carry identity or structure.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper and canvas work surfaces framed by deep navy command areas
Purple and teal as stable port/starboard identities
Brass and sand for emphasis, loading, and tournament ornament
Asymmetric rounded corners that suggest fitted plates rather than generic cards
Strong player names with compact uppercase labels and telemetry
Motion only when a set or score changes

rules.name: The Side Identity Rule
rules.body: Purple is port/player one; teal is starboard/player two. Do not swap those meanings to decorate unrelated state.

rules.name: The Player Name Rule
rules.body: Player names receive the strongest type weight; seed, pronoun, location, and social metadata must truncate before the name becomes unreadable.

rules.name: The Structural Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows explain stacking, pressability, or broadcast separation; they are not ambient decoration for every panel.

dos: Do preserve horizontally readable bracket chronology on narrow screens.
Do keep connection and freshness state visible, textual, and timestamped.
Do truncate long metadata before player names or scores collide.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion for score, helm, and set transitions.
Do reserve the richer nautical material treatment for set cards, the scene rail, and the overlay.
donts: Don't turn every dashboard region into an equal floating card.
Don't add generic blue gradients; the existing texture vocabulary is paper, paint, brass, and fitted plates.
Don't repurpose purple and teal so side identity becomes ambiguous.
Don't use continuous ambient motion when tournament state is unchanged.
Don't rely on color alone for connection, error, or freshness state.
